caption:
PART 2/2 — 53 minutes after the first hit, Nordbay struck New Orleans again. ⚠️🚢

Damaged and still moving, the empty Aframax had to round Algiers Point. Tugs were turned away, the master was on the phone — and at 23:06 she hit the Mandeville Street Wharf. Total damage: about $6.4 million.

NTSB lessons: a pilot on board never removes the master's duty to navigate safely, and no call is more important than a ship still under way.

What would you have done? 👇

Source: NTSB Marine Accident Brief MAB-17/30 (public report). Animated illustration, not a reconstruction.

scenes.headline: [Previously...]

items: 22:13 — hit a dock and the city's water intakes

scenes.narration: Previously. An empty tanker, a river running high, and a dock destroyed at Nine-Mile Point. Nordbay is damaged... but still moving.

scenes.headline: Plan: [anchor] below Algiers Point.
scenes.narration: Twenty-two eighteen. The pilot calls for tugs, and decides to anchor below Algiers Point, a sharp bend in the heart of the city. A relief pilot is arranged.

p.text: Two tugs offer their lines. The pilot [declines.]
p.by: At this speed, he fears dragging them

scenes.narration: Twenty-two thirty-seven. Two tugs come alongside and offer their lines. The pilot declines. At this speed, he fears dragging them.

scenes.headline: [22:58] Full ahead.
scenes.sub: Next: hard starboard around Algiers Point
scenes.narration: Twenty-two fifty-eight. She passes under the Crescent City Connection bridges. Full ahead. Now she must swing hard to starboard, around Algiers Point.

scenes.headline: And the master? [On the phone.]
scenes.narration: And the master? At that very moment, he is on a phone call with the shipping company.

p.text: Emergency... [as much as you can give me!]

scenes.narration: Twenty-three oh four. The pilot calls out. Emergency! As much as you can give me! The master ends his call, and orders full sea speed.

scenes.headline: [Too late.]
scenes.sub: Rate of turn falling · danger signal
scenes.narration: Too late. Her rate of turn is falling. Twenty-three oh five. The danger signal sounds again.

scenes.headline: [23:06] Second allision.
scenes.narration: Twenty-three oh six. Nordbay strikes the Mandeville Street Wharf.

scenes.headline: The bill: [$6.4 million].

items: City water intakes damaged — still working
Nordbay: 5 propeller blades damaged, buckled steel aft

scenes.narration: Total damage, about six point four million dollars. Nordbay herself had five damaged propeller blades, and buckled steel in her stern.

scenes.headline: What the [NTSB] found.

items: Risks of handling an empty ship in high water not properly assessed
Strong current behind her, turning into the wind
Bridge team lost track of the ship's position
2nd hit: master distracted by a phone call

scenes.narration: The NTSB found that the pilot and the master did not properly assess the risks of handling an empty ship in high water, with a strong current behind her, turning into the wind. The bridge team lost track of the ship's position. And for the second hit, the master was distracted by a phone call.

scenes.headline: [Lessons] for every bridge.

items: A pilot on board never removes the master's duty
After an accident, no call matters more than a ship still moving
Talk through wind, current and ballast condition before the bend

scenes.narration: The lessons. A pilot on board never removes the master's duty to navigate safely. After an accident, no phone call is more important than a ship that is still moving. And talk through the wind, the current and the ship's condition before the bend, not in it.
